correctness.rationale: Conditional void survival on an interval is exp(−integrated intensity); conditional on Poisson refresh cuts, independent plateau-rate averaging gives E∏φ(|I|). Splitting a plateau strictly decreases its product by (1/2)E[(e^(−uL)−e^(−uL′))(e^(−vL)−e^(−vL′))]>0 for nondegenerate ν. Coupled Poisson superposition establishes all t monotonicity; the no-prior-mark/exactly-one-added-mark event produces the stated positive gap with factor (μ2−μ1)e^(−μ2t). Jensen and integrated covariance 2 Var(λ)∫_0^t(t−u)e^(−μu)du give strict endpoint bounds and fast limit. The Brownian stationary position is sqrt(2D A)Z, and all positive Gaussian-radius tails increase with A. Independently diagonalized a three-state finite generator / matrix-exponential Feynman–Kac system for several μ and confirmed decreasing void probabilities. Finite diagnostics support, not substitute for the coupling proof.
